text:
Ava (eng-sre): Heads up — postmortem actions from INC-834 need owner re-verify before we close. I did a pass in the sheet and flagged 3 items with unclear owners. Can folks confirm? TL;DR: canary rollback test + db migration monitoring + alert tuning.

Mike (eng-platform): I'm owner for the canary rollback test. Plan to run in staging tomorrow 10:00am PT, tentative due 2024-06-05. I'll add the test checklist to the sheet.

Omar (eng-ml): DB monitoring was originally assigned to Priya, but she moved teams last sprint. @Priya can you confirm or reassign?

Priya (eng): I can pick up the DB monitoring piece, but I need a co-owner for after-hours coverage. @Jordan could you pair on runbook + on-call handover?

Jordan (product): I can be a co-owner for the runbook and alert params. Meeting at 11:30 PT but I'll update the sheet after.

Ava (eng-sre): Awesome. Please lock due dates in the sheet and add a short summary of steps. Sheet link: https://docs.internal/redwood/inc-834-actions (will update permissions). Also confirm alert threshold we decided: `error_rate > 5% for 5m`.

DevOps Bot: Reminder: incident postmortem INC-834 actions due in 3 days. :bell:

Mike (eng-platform): Added the canary test plan to the doc. Failure scenarios + rollback commands included. Quick snippet for rollback:`kubectl rollout undo deployment/api --to-revision=3`

Priya (eng): Assigning monitoring to myself and @Jordan, due 2024-06-07 EOD. I'll tag owners in the sheet. Need one thing: I don't have the monitoring creds to hook to new metrics. @infra-team can you grant read-only?

InfraBot: Access request recorded: #AR-998. ETA ~6 hours.

Ava (eng-sre): Thanks — last ask: whoever is owner please ping #eng-oncall when the canary runs, and add a trace-id example to the runbook so oncall can validate.

Jordan (product): Ack. I'll post a quick checklist in the runbook and tag oncall. Also adding a short example trace id: `trace: 20240603-834-ab12`.

Mike (eng-platform): Small ask — can someone validate perms for the rollback script in prod? @Sam (eng-security)?

Sam (eng-security): I will validate the rollback script permissions and confirm by EOD today.

Priya (eng): Quick blockers: need monitoring creds (see AR-998) and a metric name from infra for the new DB exporter. @infra-team please share metric name when available.

InfraBot: Metric name published to the ticket: `db.migrations.duration_ms`.

Ava (eng-sre): Sweet. Closing loop: owners confirmed: Mike (canary), Priya + Jordan (db monitoring/runbook), Sam (security perms). I'll update the incident channel and mark the spreadsheet status as `owners-verified` :white_check_mark:

Jordan (product): One more item — can we add an on-call burn-rate check to the pager? Suggested rule: `pager if latency_p95 > 2s for 10m`.

Priya (eng): +1 to the burn-rate check.

Mike (eng-platform): Sounds good. Thanks all — I'll kick off the staging canary and post results.

Ava (eng-sre): Thanks team. If anything slips, flag it here and we'll reopen the action. :v:
